summary.content:
Today's selection covers 117 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 80 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI’s Big Reset + A.I. in the Doctor’s Office + Talkie, a pre-1930s LLM
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hugging Face, ClawHub Abused for Malware Distribution
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BBC Technology, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours
